Task #857: Run criteria on a pass sample

Make `run-criteria.py` able to run each `[check]` on a sample of its expected pass, so a check that can never pass is caught before the task is filed.

- Lesson (memory `pitfall-unrun-criterion-command`, confirmed 6 times): run every `[check]` command on its pass path before filing, not only on the base.
- Repeat 2026-10-24, #840: criterion 1 passed `run-criteria.py --base`, then failed at the head with a traceback, since `check-schema.py check /dev/stdin` reads a valid document twice: https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/840#issuecomment-6379112301.
- Proposal: a check step, not a written rule, such as a `--pass <sample-file>` mode that substitutes a sample for the command's input, or a lint warning on `/dev/stdin` in a command.
